sentences.japanese: 僕が最後に自分の考えを伝えた人は、僕を気違いだと思ったようだ。
sentences.english: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.

sentences.japanese: 出発する前に私に電話するよう、彼らに伝えてください。
sentences.english: Tell them to call me before they leave.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼に真実を伝えた方がよい。
sentences.english: You should tell him the truth.

sentences.japanese: 彼に本当のことを伝えた方がいいよ。
sentences.english: You should tell him the truth.

sentences.japanese: 君は英語で自分の意志を伝えられますか。
sentences.english: Can you make yourself understood in English?
